title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1973-03-19
source: Recording Info: SBD > Master Reels > Dat (16-bit/44.1k) > upsampled to 24-bit/96k; Mastering Info: WAV > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24; Master Reel Transferred by Rob Eaton; All Mastering By Charlie Miller; the original version of this source had a 2 second dropout in thrack 16 (Playing In The Band)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording delivers a crisp capture of an outstanding early‑1973 first set highlighted by He’s Gone, Box of Rain and Playing in the Band, though a few listeners note occasional mumble.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its tight, flowing first set with masterful solos from Jerry – especially on He’s Gone, They Love Each Other and Box of Rain – and a seamless jam sequence that keeps momentum for over three hours. The Mr. Miller soundboard source is generally described as polished and clear, but one reviewer complained about “mumble fests,” giving the overall impression of a good‑quality recording with minor flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews highlight an excellent performance and solid soundboard quality, while one 0‑star review points to noticeable audio issues, resulting in a balanced mixed overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally praised as polished and clear; Mr. Miller’s tape is considered a ‘godsend’ by fans, though one listener mentioned occasional mumble/fest moments.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers note a consistent momentum and superb sequencing that makes this first set one of the strongest of 1973, with seamless transitions and an engaging overall arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His solo passages on He’s Gone, They Love Each Other and Box of Rain are singled out as masterful and majestic.
